backend/main.mo: Defines core backend data models including users, providers, clients, jobs, documents, OTPs, and platform stats within an actor canister.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records mapping features to affected files, components, and tests with high-confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for numerous frontend files describing their roles, UI behavior, and logic integrations.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS variables, themes, and base styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entrypoint setting up PWA metadata, icons, and loading the React application.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Specifies the domain used for IC verification.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, theme colors, and categories.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page shown when the app has no network connection.
frontend/public/sw.js: Versioned service worker handling caching, offline support, skip-waiting messages, and IC-safe fetch rules.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication, routing state, data fetching, and service worker registration.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides shared page layout with header, footer, and support drawer around page content.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles login/logout via Internet Identity with UI states and react-query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/PhoneOtpVer: Manages phone number OTP flow including sending, verifying, and showing errors or success messages.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: Lets new users select a role and creates minimal profiles based on that role.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders app footer with copyright, support trigger, and caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays top navigation with role‑based menu items, login button, and mobile menu drawer.
frontend/src/components/landing/DemoVide: Placeholder section showing a demo video area describing how the app works.
frontend/src/components/landing/Platform: Displays animated client and provider stats using minimum thresholds and backend values, with loading skeletons shown until data is fetched.
frontend/src/components/landing/RoleQuic: Provides quick role selection cards that trigger login or navigation based on authentication state and selected user role.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Renders a grid of hardcoded client testimonials with ratings, reviewer info, and provider avatars.
frontend/src/components/landing/useLandi: Empty placeholder file with no implemented logic.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Allows users to input or auto-detect their address and coordinates using browser geolocation.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Implements a simple message panel with simulated send/refresh actions and a scrollable message list.
frontend/src/components/notifications/En: Shows a temporary dismissible alert indicating whether a provider is engaged or not.
frontend/src/components/payments/MpesaUn: Displays a dialog for unlocking provider contact details via simulated M-Pesa payment, handling input, processing, and success states.
frontend/src/components/providers/Featur: Renders a provider avatar with fallback initials and size options, handling image load errors.
Displays a grid of demo featured provider cards with avatars, ratings, and basic details.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Shows a provider avatar using a profile image or generated initials with adjustable sizes.
Renders a provider profile card including avatar, verification and engagement status, rating, and rate info.
Provides a dialog preview of a provider with avatar, verification, availability, and rating summaries.
frontend/src/components/providers/Unlock: Displays a paywall card explaining and charging a connection fee to unlock provider contact details.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallPromp: Shows a banner prompting users to install the PWA, with special handling for iOS instructions.
frontend/src/components/pwa/UpdateAvaila: Displays a banner notifying users of a new app version with an option to refresh and update.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Displays average ratings with full, half, and empty stars and handles zero-rating states.
Interactive star rating input component allowing users to select a rating unless readonly.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: Drawer UI component showing phone and email support contact options.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUpOnVisible.t: Counts up from a start value to an end value when the referenced element becomes visible.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, managing login, logout, and identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Handles PWA installation prompts, detecting installability and managing the user prompt flow.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, OTP, locations, and provider/client operations using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Detects service worker updates and provides a method to trigger update-and-reload behavior.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind config with light/dark theme variables and custom landing hero background styles.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines the Category interface and a list of service categories with IDs, labels, business types, and icons.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ClientAccessPage: Client login/create flow using Internet Identity and phone OTP verification.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ProviderAccessPa: Provider login/create flow with Internet Identity and OTP verification.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Admin page scaffold for reviewing and verifying provider accounts.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Displays searchable service categories and navigates to results on selection.
frontend/src/pages/client/ClientProfileP: Shows client profile details and allows updating the pinned location.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Placeholder page for map-based provider viewing with a notice that the feature is not yet available.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Displays a placeholder for job tracking and links back to service browsing.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Loads provider details with live updates, unlock flow, ratings, and engagement status handling.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Fetches and displays provider search results with a preview dialog and engagement status updates.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page combining hero section, navigation logic, feature sections, and promotional content.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Allows providers to manage their profile, pinned location, engagement status, and editable profile fields.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: Renders provider verification status using user profile data and displays placeholders for future document upload functionality.
frontend/src/utils/engagementTime.ts: Provides helpers to compute remaining engagement time, format it for display, and check expiration based on nanosecond timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/fees.ts: Calculates a 10% connection fee from a bigint rate and formats KES currency values for display.
Stores, retrieves, and clears a pending user role in sessionStorage with validation against known roles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Parses URL and hash parameters, syncs them with sessionStorage, and manages persisted URL parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, fonts, containers, and custom utilities using plugins and extended design tokens.
project_state.json: Tracks the project’s current state, architecture notes, known issues, and feature definitions for the Genz App.
